title: Angular chibi bases
question: Which base should we continue fitting clothes to?

options.label: v15-flat: fewer head planes
options.note: 744 triangles. Two head rounding bands removed; flat shading. Body shape, eyes and rig carried over from v14. View beside the current game model in the live comparison.

options.label: v14-flat: shading change only
options.note: 792 triangles. Same v14 geometry with flat shading, under the same office lights.

options.label: v14-smooth: earlier shading
options.note: Previous smooth normals, under the office lights. Included to separate the effect of lighting from shading.

media.caption: Phone layout of the live comparison.

decision: v15-flat, simplify the body more (fat rolls), then dress it with clothes and hair to replicate Mio and Eric
